scientific limitations/integrity: The power-closure conclusion is a sufficient criterion and does not resolve the general power-closure question. The forced-band proof is exact; the least-720 assertion is a finite exhaustive complement-pair subset computation replayed by the supplied verifier. The leastness concerns existence of a representation omitting \(1,n\), not whether 720 has some other representation containing it.
title: Abundance-forced power closure for strongly pseudoperfect numbers
